title_hi: Ye column table mein nahi hai
explain_en: The query names a column that doesn't exist in that table, usually a typo or an old name.
explain_hi: Query mein jo column likha hai wo table mein nahi hai. Aksar spelling galat hoti hai ya naam purana hota hai.

fix.note: Suggest the closest real column name from the schema map, then ask before re-running.

title_hi: Column do tables mein hai, kaunsa chahiye saaf nahi
explain_en: Two joined tables both have a column with this name, so the database doesn't know which one you mean.
explain_hi: Jin tables ko joda hai, dono mein is naam ka column hai. Database ko nahi pata kaunsa lena hai.

fix.note: Prefix the column with its table name (orders.id).

title_hi: Ye table database mein nahi hai
explain_en: The query references a table that does not exist in the selected database.
explain_hi: Query mein jo table likha hai wo is database mein nahi hai.

fix.note: Verify the selected database, table name, case sensitivity, prefix, and migration state. Do not create a replacement table until you know what schema is expected.

title_hi: Ye column table mein nahi hai
explain_en: The query names a column that doesn't exist. In PostgreSQL, names with capital letters must be in double quotes.
explain_hi: Query mein jo column likha hai wo nahi hai. PostgreSQL mein capital letters wale naam double quotes mein likhne padte hain.

fix.note: Suggest the closest real column; if only the case differs, add double quotes.

match: 42803|must appear in the GROUP BY clause
title_hi: GROUP BY mein column missing hai
explain_en: When you group rows, every column you show must either be in GROUP BY or inside a total like COUNT or SUM.
explain_hi: Jab rows ko group karte ho, to jo bhi column dikhana hai wo ya GROUP BY mein ho ya COUNT/SUM jaise total mein.

fix.note: Add the plain columns of the SELECT list to GROUP BY.

explain_en: An INSERT or UPDATE is trying to create a duplicate value for a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE index.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: duplicate value.

fix.note: Check the key named in the error and the duplicate value. Use a unique value, update the existing row, or fix the application logic that generated the duplicate.

match: (?:1452|cannot add or update a child row: a foreign key constraint fails)
explain_en: A child row contains a foreign-key value that does not exist in the referenced parent table.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: missing parent row.

fix.note: Verify the foreign-key value and insert/select the correct parent row before inserting or updating the child.

match: (?:1451|cannot delete or update a parent row: a foreign key constraint fails)
explain_en: A parent row cannot be deleted or changed because child rows still reference it.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: referenced row exists.

fix.note: Handle the child rows first, or use an appropriate ON DELETE/ON UPDATE rule only if that behavior is correct for the data model.

explain_en: The value is larger than the maximum size allowed by the target column.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: value is too long.

fix.note: Check the incoming value length and the column definition. Trim or validate bad input, or enlarge the column only when the business data genuinely needs more space.

explain_en: The database reported: incorrect number value.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: incorrect number value.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

match: (?:1064|you have an error in your sql syntax)
explain_en: MySQL/MariaDB could not parse the SQL statement because its syntax is invalid.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: sql syntax error.

fix.note: Check the SQL near the location reported by the server for misspelled keywords, missing commas or parentheses, invalid quoting, or malformed clauses.

explain_en: The database reported: max allowed packet exceeded.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: max allowed packet exceeded.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The statement waited too long for another transaction to release a lock.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: lock wait timed out.

fix.note: Find the blocking transaction, shorten long transactions, commit or rollback promptly, and make sure frequently filtered/updated rows are indexed appropriately.

match: (?:1213|deadlock found when trying to get lock)
explain_en: Two or more transactions locked resources in conflicting order, so MySQL aborted one transaction to break the deadlock.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: transaction deadlock.

fix.note: Retry the aborted transaction and make transactions acquire rows/tables in a consistent order. Keep transactions short and index lookup conditions.

explain_en: The database reported: connection limit reached.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: connection limit reached.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: MySQL rejected the connection because the username, password, host permission, or authentication setup did not match.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: login denied.

fix.note: Verify the username, password, connecting host, and account host pattern. Grant only the privileges the application actually needs.

explain_en: The connection requested a database that does not exist on this server.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: database does not exist.

fix.note: Check the configured database name and server. Create the database only if it is genuinely missing and should exist.

explain_en: The database reported: server connection was lost.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: server connection was lost.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_hi: Database ne bataya: table storage is full.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The database reported: foreign key cannot be created.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: foreign key cannot be created.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The database reported: check constraint failed.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: check constraint failed.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The database reported: required value missing.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: required value missing.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The database reported: value was truncated.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: value was truncated.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The database reported: server is read only.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: server is read only.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: A row is trying to use a value that must be unique, but that value already exists.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: duplicate value.

fix.note: Find the unique constraint named in the error, identify the duplicate value, then either use a different value or update the existing row instead of inserting another duplicate.

match: (?:23502|null value in column .* violates not-null constraint)
explain_en: A required column received NULL even though the column is defined NOT NULL.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: required value missing.

fix.note: Provide a valid value for the named column, or add a sensible default only if the application truly allows one.

explain_en: The row references another row that does not exist, or a parent row is being changed while dependent rows still reference it.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: foreign key failed.

fix.note: Check the foreign-key column and referenced table. Insert or select a valid parent row first, or handle dependent child rows before changing/deleting the parent.

explain_en: The row failed a CHECK constraint, meaning one or more values do not satisfy a rule defined on the table.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: check constraint failed.

fix.note: Inspect the named CHECK constraint and correct the row values so they satisfy the rule. Do not remove the constraint unless the business rule itself is wrong.

explain_en: A value cannot be converted to the PostgreSQL data type requested by the query. For example, text such as 'abc' cannot be cast to an integer.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: invalid value type.

fix.note: Check the value and destination column/type. Validate or clean the input before casting or inserting it; do not change the column type unless the stored data truly requires it.

match: (?:42601|syntax error at or near|syntax error at end of input)
explain_en: PostgreSQL could not parse the SQL statement. The error usually points near the token where parsing stopped, but the actual mistake may be just before it.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: sql syntax error.

fix.note: Check the SQL around the reported token for a misspelled keyword, missing comma, missing parenthesis, or malformed clause. Correct the SQL and retry.

explain_en: The query refers to a table, view, sequence, or other relation PostgreSQL cannot find in the current schema search path.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: table does not exist.

fix.note: Verify the object name, schema, connection database, and search_path. Use a schema-qualified name when needed.

explain_en: The connected PostgreSQL role does not have permission to access the requested object or perform the requested operation.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: permission denied.

fix.note: Grant only the minimum required privilege to the application role, or run the operation with the correct authorized role.

match: (?:57014|canceling statement due to statement timeout|canceling statement due to user request)
explain_en: PostgreSQL cancelled the statement before it finished, commonly because statement_timeout was reached.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: statement timed out.

fix.note: Identify why the query is slow first: inspect its plan, indexes, filters, joins, and lock waits. Increase the timeout only when the workload legitimately needs more time.

explain_en: An earlier statement failed inside the current transaction, so PostgreSQL will reject later statements until the transaction is rolled back.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: transaction is aborted.

fix.note: ROLLBACK the failed transaction, fix the original error, then retry the transaction from the beginning.

explain_en: The database reported: transaction deadlock.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: transaction deadlock.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The database reported: connection limit reached.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: connection limit reached.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_hi: Database ne bataya: concurrent transaction conflict.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_hi: Database ne bataya: value is too long.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The database reported: number is out of range.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: number is out of range.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_en: The query attempted to divide a number by zero.
explain_hi: Database ne bataya: division by zero.

fix.note: Protect the divisor, for example with NULLIF(divisor, 0), or filter zero values when zero is not a valid denominator.

explain_hi: Database ne bataya: invalid date value.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.

explain_hi: Database ne bataya: transaction is read only.

fix.note: Check the named object and values, make the smallest safe correction, then retry.
